offering_description.value: Cresco Labs sells cannabis products to licensed dispensaries, adult-use consumers and medical cannabis patients. It grows and processes cannabis, distributes finished products to other dispensaries and sells directly through its own stores.

primary_products.value: Cannabis flower; pre-rolls; vape cartridges; concentrates; edibles

customer_segment.value: B2B: Licensed cannabis dispensaries; B2C: Adult-use cannabis consumers and medical cannabis patients

revenue_model.value: product sales: Wholesale and retail sales of cannabis products

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Grows cannabis and makes finished products for licensed dispensaries and its own stores; distributor: Supplies finished cannabis products to third-party licensed dispensaries; retailer: Stocks its own and third-party cannabis products for adult-use consumers and medical patients

geography_served.value: US regional: Selected states in the Midwest, Northeast and Southeast, including Illinois, Pennsylvania and Florida

specialization.value: related lines: Cannabis cultivation, finished-product manufacturing, wholesale distribution and dispensary retail

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Wholesale sales to licensed dispensaries; own locations: Company-operated dispensaries; online: Dispensary websites for ordering and store pickup

regulatory_exposure.value: high: State cannabis agencies license cultivation, processing, distribution and retail and enforce testing and inventory tracking requirements.

notes: The full current list of states where Cresco operates is uncertain.
